LanguageData.VWEFT_Gun_HandheldGatlingGun.description: A heavy weapon meant as a portable turret, dismantled from its base and now carryable by strong individuals, power armor, or a powered exosuit. Despite this, the gun still requires hand cranking to reach maximum fire rate and now has a limited ammo supply.\n\nAs a last line of defense, many frontiersmen claim to land incredibly lucky shots with this weapon, swiftly turning enemies into fine red mist.
